observed_behavior: Original workers included the coordinator accepted obligation document in evidence for focused QA that did not consume that document, making the retained proof impossible to certify.
expected_behavior: QA evidence records actual command inputs; frozen leases retain coordinator authority separately.
causal_mechanism: Instructions requested relevant tracked inputs without distinguishing authority-only reads from QA-consumed inputs. Certificate assessment correctly requires all QA inputs and rejects self-certifying accepted-state bytes.

anti_pattern.structural_description: An operational evidence instruction leaves the provenance boundary between authority and QA consumption ambiguous.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: A worker can overstate QA inputs and introduce a self-reference that immutable certificate assessment cannot accept.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Every recorded QA input is actually consumed by that command; authority-only reads stay in the frozen lease.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Instructions state the consumption boundary and require reporting incompatible proof scope if QA genuinely consumes accepted-state bytes, rather than omitting real inputs or rewriting evidence.

applicability_conditions: Workers read mutable coordinator authority that their recorded QA command does not consume.
known_non_matches: A genuinely consumed input must remain in evidence even when certificate scope is incompatible.
confirmation_evidence: GWEN original worker101 and107 submissions included obligations.json authority reads in structural QA evidence.
Source certificateReasons requires evidence-input coverage and acceptIncrementCertificates rejects accepted-document self-coverage.
regression_proofs: tests/rolling-worker.test.ts: worker instructions retain exact obligation, requirement, acceptance step, lease and QA selections
